yaw_pitch_convention.yaw_deg: atan2(Rr[0,2], Rr[2,2]) with Rr = R_i^T R_{i+1}, c2w OpenCV (x right, y down, z forward)
yaw_pitch_convention.pitch_deg: asin(-Rr[1,2]); positive = camera up (ABot I, MG2 +mouse[0], Waypoint +mouse[1])
yaw_pitch_convention.translation: tr = R_i^T (t_{i+1} - t_i); tr[2] > 0 forward (W), tr[0] > 0 strafe right (D)
yaw_pitch_convention.positive_yaw_maps_to: ABot key L, Waypoint +mouse[0], MG2 +mouse[1], Astra M[0,2] < 0 (its 'Rotate Right' form)
yaw_pitch_convention.geometric_note: positive yaw rotates the forward axis toward camera +x = the camera pans RIGHT (content flows left) in OpenCV c2w; PROTOCOL.md §2 labels it RIGHT since 10/17 (the 10/16 text said 'left'). Verified on the baselines' own P2 outputs: Waypoint (DA3, waypoint/smoke/calib_da3.json 'camera pans RIGHT'), MG2 (DA3, mg2/smoke/calib_P2_universal_0000.json sign_ok), ABot (L key = web_client/config.py 右, smoke frames), Astra (astra/calib_astra.json direction_check: content moves LEFT = camera pans RIGHT). Code: StEvo generator 'right-30' = +48 deg/s by this formula, Matrix-Game-2 utils/conditions.py camera_r = [0, +0.1], tools/waypoint/run_waypoint.py '--mouse-x (right turn)', Astra cam_type 3 'Rotate Right' = Ry(-0.03) relative = our +yaw.

waypoint.source: K_yaw 68 (10/17 FINAL): proportional least-squares fit total_yaw = c * mouse_units over eight 10-s P2 clips of highland_castle_loch generated through baselines/waypoint/run.sh with 64-95 mouse units/call (K 53.6/64.7/66/69/79, seeds 1234/1235; DA3 pose recovery baselines/waypoint/calib_yaw.py -> waypoint/smoke/calib_da3.json, fit waypoint/smoke/kyaw_fit.json): c = 2.214 deg/unit -> K = 150/c = 67.8 -> 68 (affine 67.8, power-law 67.9). Direct clips bracket it: K 66 -> 161/168 deg, K 69 -> 203/176, K 79 -> 220/207 (the 10/16 one-clip proposal 79 over-rotates). The realised turn at a fixed input varies ~6 % rms between seeds and processes, so K is a fit, not a one-clip value; expected P2 pan at K 68 = 181 +- 11 deg. Response ~linear in 64-95 units/call (exponent 0.97), ramps over the first ~2 s. fps: tools/waypoint/Waypoint-1.5-1B/config.yaml inference_fps 60, temporal_compression 4 (15 calls/s)

astra.pose_format: one 13-vector per latent j: flattened 3x4 M_j + mask (0; the inference code overwrites it); M_j = E[4j+4] @ inv(E[4j]) on the training extrinsics = motion latent j -> j+1 (train_single.py create_sekai_pose_embeddings; infer_demo.py real-pose path)
astra.mapping_from_protocol_c2w: T_rel = inv(c2w[4j]) @ c2w[4j+4] (OpenCV camera-frame relative c2w); M_j = S T_rel[:3,:] S' with S = diag(1,-1,-1), S' = diag(1,-1,-1,1): protocol +yaw (pan right) -> M[0,2] < 0 = Astra 'Rotate Right' (cam_type 3 = Ry(-0.03)); forward +z -> M[2,3] < 0 = Astra 'Move Forward' (cam_type 1: M[2,3] = -0.03). Strafe / pitch signs not exercised by the programs (unverified)

u_scale_decision_da3.consequence_for_metrics: Astra's RPE-Trans on P3/P4/P5 will reflect the dropped translation; P2/P3 RPE-Rot the 1.5x drifted pan; both are the model's behaviour at the protocol's rates (18 deg/s = 2.1x its preset), a slower P2' is the fair complement (PROTOCOL rule 2)

previous_convert_py_entry.pose_format: one 13-vector per latent j: flattened 3x4 M_j + mask (0; the inference code overwrites it); M_j = E[4j+4] @ inv(E[4j]) on the training extrinsics = motion latent j -> j+1 (train_single.py create_sekai_pose_embeddings; infer_demo.py real-pose path)
previous_convert_py_entry.mapping_from_protocol_c2w: T_rel = inv(c2w[4j]) @ c2w[4j+4] (OpenCV camera-frame relative c2w); M_j = S T_rel[:3,:] S' with S = diag(1,-1,-1), S' = diag(1,-1,-1,1): protocol +yaw (pan right) -> M[0,2] < 0 = Astra 'Rotate Right' (cam_type 3 = Ry(-0.03)); forward +z -> M[2,3] < 0 = Astra 'Move Forward' (cam_type 1: M[2,3] = -0.03). Strafe / pitch signs not exercised by the programs (unverified)
previous_convert_py_entry.rotation: exact: yaw_deg_per_latent = yaw_deg_per_s * 4 / 20 (P2: 3.6 deg = 0.0628 rad per latent; P2p: 3.2 deg; Astra's presets: 0.03 rad = 1.72 deg per latent = 8.6 deg/s)
previous_convert_py_entry.translation_rule: 1 u/s == Astra's own preset forward speed 0.03 per latent step (cam_type 1/4/5/6 forward_speed) = 0.03 * 20 / 4 = 0.15 units/s, i.e. 0.0075 per video frame at 20 fps
